name: Ice Melee
description: Ice Melee allows the player to use Cold-based attacks, and even conjure up frozen melee weapons. Ice Melee powers are known for their ability to slow an opponent.

powers.name: Frozen Fists
powers.description: Frozen Fists encrusts your hands in ice, giving them the ability to quickly inflict minor damage on villains. The foe's attack and movement speed is Slowed, due to the chills caused by the cold blows.  Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Ice Sword
powers.description: You create a blade of solid ice that deals good damage. Being hit by this Ice Sword will Slow a target's movement and attack speed, due to the intense chill. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Frost
powers.description: You create a short cone of Frost in front of you that can deal some damage and Slow a foe's speed, due to their uncontrollable shivering. Damage: Moderate(DoT), Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your Accuracy. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Greater Ice Sword
powers.description: Your mastery of Ice allows you to create an enhanced blade of solid ice that deals above average damage. Being hit by the Greater Ice Sword will Slow a villain's attack and movement speed, due to the intense chill. Damage: High, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Confront
powers.description: Challenges a foe to attack you. Useful to pull a villain off an ally who finds themselves in over their head. A To Hit check required to Taunt enemy players, but is not needed against critter targets. Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Ice Patch
powers.description: You emanate a Patch of Ice around you. Foes that step onto the Ice Patch will slip and fall down. This effect lasts until the ice melts. You must be near the ground to activate this power. Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Freezing Touch
powers.description: This Freezing Touch will encase a single foe in a block of ice. This will deal high damage over time, as well as freezing him in his tracks, leaving him cold and helpless. Damage:High(DoT), Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Frozen Aura
powers.description: Your mastery of cold enables you to dramatically lower the temperature immediately around you. When you perform a Frozen Aura, nearby foes will be frozen within a fragile casing of ice and suffer a moderate amount of cold damage. These frozen foes will break free if attacked. Frozen Aura deals moderate damage. Damage: Moderate Recharge: Slow
